description: This code creates variable nodes and keeps name-value pairs in a fixed-size symbol table.

steps.description: create_var creates a NODE_VAR node and saves its name.
The table holds up to 100 name and value pairs. table_size tracks the used entries.
set_var updates an existing matching name or adds a new pair.
get_var returns a matching value. If no name matches, it reports an undefined variable and exits.

title: Store calculator variables
